text.content:
Sect: Camarilla

The Toreador are patrons and creators of art and culture, drawn overwhelmingly from artists, performers, critics, and aesthetes captivated by beauty in all its forms. Alongside genuine devotion to creative pursuits, the clan also harbors no shortage of sycophants, hedonists, and pleasure-seekers.

Disciplines: Auspex, Celerity, Presence

Advantage: Toreador possess a refined and often supernatural appreciation for beauty, granting them bonuses when evaluating or creating works of art and culture.

Disadvantage: A Toreador can become transfixed when encountering art or beauty of sufficient magnificence, losing track of their surroundings while enraptured.

Organization: Central to Camarilla high society, often found among its elite hosting salons, galleries, and performances that double as venues for politics and intrigue.

See also: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{the Camarilla}, of which Toreador is one of the founding clans.
